# The Book of Tomás Esteban — Full Stack Developer & Architect Portfolio

> Tomás Esteban González Quintero (TEGQ) is a Full Stack Developer and Systems Architect based in Bucaramanga, Colombia. Specializing in high-performance web systems, .NET 8, React Native, Three.js 3D WebGL, Supabase, n8n AI agent workflows, and distributed architectures.

## Featured Projects

- [Campuslands Inteligente](https://github.com/TEstebanGQ/campuslands-inteligente): Intelligent campus automation system.

- [GitHub MCP Server](https://github.com/TEstebanGQ/github-mcp-server): Model Context Protocol server for seamless GitHub interactions.
- [HelpDesk AI](https://github.com/TEstebanGQ/HelpDeskAI): Automated AI-powered IT ticketing and help desk system.
